source_registry.title: Advancing the Rodl Nibble: New bounds on matchings and the list chromatic index of hypergraphs
H1b-COV1a explicit covering constant
source_registry.source_locations: all-parameter proof law and explicit C0

weighted_second_moment.weights: fixed complex b_v on a pre-covering vertex set of size M
weighted_second_moment.exact_expansion: E abs(sum_v b_v X_v)^2=sum_v P_v abs(b_v)^2+sum_(v!=w)P_vw b_v conjugate(b_w)
weighted_second_moment.loss: beta*rho^2(M-1) is the worst-case spectral loss from entrywise pair errors

sharpness_fixture.law: a fair latent coin selects iid Bernoulli(1/8) or iid Bernoulli(3/8)
sharpness_fixture.conclusion: The beta*M scaling cannot be removed using only the stated entrywise one/two-point data.

project_scale.spectral_loss: beta*M>468*c*X/a and beta*rho*M>468*c*X/(a*b)>1 on the existing child range
project_scale.meaning: The available entrywise pair certificate is not a small covariance-operator bound.

gould_kelly_applicability.hypergraph: uniform nearly D-regular hypergraph with codegree sequence
gould_kelly_applicability.weights: preselected nonnegative vertex functions satisfying P1--P3
gould_kelly_applicability.conclusion: existence of a matching with weighted leftover bounds
gould_kelly_applicability.constants: asymptotic hierarchy, not numerical multiplier and finite cutoff
gould_kelly_applicability.current_law: indexed variable-size random edge families, conditional covering output, same-law probability moment
gould_kelly_applicability.complex_phase: not directly handled; splitting into nonnegative parts does not repair law/regularity/quantitative mismatch

not_claimed: The actual covariance operator has large norm.
Gould--Kelly cannot inspire a redesigned construction.
All weighted nibble theorems are inapplicable.
The blind prime-error weights saturate the common-shock counterexample.
PAP-11, DEP-R09, fixed 2e-17, or numerical X_cert is closed.
next_gate: Obtain a numerical covariance-operator or direct event-energy correlation theorem for the actual nonuniform indexed covering law; fixed one/two-point entrywise errors and current weighted matching theorems do not supply the required blind complex moment.
